entity.name: Shashank Shekhar Singh
entity.description: I have built and maintain CodeGraphContext, an MIT-licensed open-source tool for structural analysis of software repositories and agent-accessible code context. I am seeking support for public maintenance, reliability, security, and adoption of this open-source infrastructure.

projects.name: CodeGraphContext
projects.description: CodeGraphContext (CGC) turns code repositories into queryable graphs of symbols, call relationships, inheritance, imports, and dependencies. It exposes code understanding through a command-line tool and an MCP server for AI agents. It supports multiple programming languages and graph database backends. The core project is MIT-licensed and developed in public. The project has been accepted as a supported project by the German Center for Open Source AI (GC.OS).

plans.name: India-based open-source reliability and maintainer support (6 months)
plans.description: Proposed one-time grant of INR 600,000 for six months of public work, subject to grantor eligibility and budget review. Budget: INR 210,000 parser correctness, language fixtures and golden regression tests; INR 120,000 reproducible cross-platform CI; INR 105,000 public parser-accuracy benchmarks and performance baselines; INR 75,000 contributor onboarding and technical documentation; INR 90,000 issue triage, releases and quarterly community engagement. Milestone 1 (months 1-2): publish prioritized language fixture matrix, baseline goldens, and reproducible correctness failures. Milestone 2 (months 3-4): improve regression pass rates and cross-platform integration checks, with public CI evidence and benchmark harness. Milestone 3 (months 5-6): publish releases, documentation and contributor guide updates, plus a public maintenance report and community update. Deliverables and checkpoints are public; no same expense or milestone will be charged to another grant. If grants overlap, budget and scope will be revised and disclosed to the funders.

plans.name: Open code-intelligence infrastructure sustainability (12 months)
plans.description: Proposed one-time USD 50,000 grant for 12 months of public work, following the FLOSS/fund grant denomination policy. This is a request, not an awarded grant. Budget: USD 20,000 for untrusted-repository threat modeling, fuzzing and security regression tests; USD 15,000 for graph database backend conformance, compatibility and query benchmarks; USD 10,000 for large-repository indexing, incremental-update and memory/latency improvements; USD 5,000 for reproducibility packages, independent test evidence and security maintenance reports. Milestone 1 (months 1-4): threat model, attack-surface inventory, adversarial corpus and initial security checks. Milestone 2 (months 5-8): public multi-backend correctness/performance matrix and fixes. Milestone 3 (months 9-12): large-repository benchmark suite, indexing improvements, release documentation and reproducible final report. This scope is distinct from the India-focused parser/CI/community plan. Any concurrent funding will be disclosed and adjusted to avoid duplicate expense or deliverable claims.
